name: Futari no Eden
source:
Middle East at the end of the 19th century. Main character accompanies a caravan across the desert. However, the caravan is attacked by bandits and annihilated. Protagonist finds himself alone with survivor girl in the middle of the vast desert. They stumble upon a hidden oasis and settle there. This place becomes a garden of Eden for the couple.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
19世纪末的中东。主角伴随着一支商队穿越沙漠。然而，商队遭到土匪袭击并被歼灭。主角发现自己和幸存者女孩独自一人在广阔的沙漠中。他们偶然发现了一个隐藏的绿洲并在那里定居下来。这个地方成了这对夫妇的伊甸园。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
